versions.content: To initiate the transmission of a queued serialized destination frame, the Bus Mirroring module shall call PduR_MirrorTransmit with PduIn- foPtr->MetaDataPtr set to the NULL_PTR and PduInfoPtr->SduLength set to the actually written part of the destination frame. If MirrorDestPduUsesTrigger- Transmit is enabled, PduInfoPtr->SduDataPtr shall be set to the NULL_PTR , otherwise to the used part of the queued destination frame.
